subject: Day 1: Score your #1 business bottleneck before touching an AI tool
goal: Identify the single repetitive process costing your company the most hours and margin each week.
body: Most business owners start with AI backward: they sign up for three new apps, try random prompts for a week, and go right back to manual operations. Today takes 10 minutes: list the 5 tasks you or your team repeated at least three times last week across lead intake, pre-call prep, inbox replies, proposals, and reporting. Score the #1 culprit on volume, repeatability, draft-gate safety, and structured trigger at https://agenticarchitect.ai/starter-kit.

subject: Day 2: Automate inbound lead research & pre-call briefs (zero coding)
goal: Eliminate 15 minutes of manual LinkedIn and website scrambling before every sales or client call.
body: Whenever a prospect books on your calendar or submits an inquiry form, a simple 3-step workflow can look up their company, summarize what they do, check fit against your pricing criteria, and drop a 1-page call brief in your inbox 30 minutes before Zoom starts. Import our ready-made workflow blueprint free from https://agenticarchitect.ai/starter-kit.

subject: Day 3: Draft-first inbox triage & 5-day proposal follow-up
goal: Reclaim 3 to 5 hours a week in email without ever letting a bot auto-send to a client.
body: Never give an AI tool unrestricted send permissions on an executive or client-facing inbox. Instead, connect read + create-draft permissions only: routine inquiries and Day-2 / Day-5 proposal nudges get staged cleanly inside Gmail Drafts so you or your assistant review and click Send in 10 seconds.

subject: Day 4: Turn call notes into scoped proposals & client onboarding checklists
goal: Cut post-call admin from 60 minutes to 5 minutes while keeping pricing decisions 100% human.
body: Deals go cold when it takes three days to type up a scope after a great conversation. Connect your meeting transcript to an approved scope template so every discovery call automatically stages a draft proposal, timeline, and internal onboarding checklist the same afternoon.
